headline: Fujiyama Power Systems discloses board meeting outcome
hook: Routine corporate filing from Fujiyama Power
summary: Fujiyama Power Systems Limited has formally submitted the outcome of its board meeting held on October 15, 2026, to the stock exchange. Such procedural filings are standard corporate governance requirements for listed entities. Indian retail investors holding shares in the company should check the official exchange portals for specific resolutions passed during the meeting. The filing itself carries no immediate financial impact on the broader market.
why_it_matters: Check exchange disclosures for specific corporate actions.
